quests.title: Whirl Islands: catch Lugia (after the final Hall of Fame)

acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame, ask Satsuki in the Dance Theater to see Lugia, then start the ceremony in Lugia’s cave. One chance: catching it, knocking it out or fleeing removes it; only losing allows a retry. If you already received Ho-Oh, the shortened Lugia menu takes the wrong branch; talk to Satsuki again and select Lugia from the full menu.
